detail.pt: php artisan kit:install --ansi no job instalacao do run 44536758392 (ubuntu-latest), sem --create-project, sem TTY, tenancy desligado (.env.example). Origem 0 ms = carimbo da linha 407 do log do job (##[group]Run cp .env.example .env) = 2026-11-19T13:46:36.5638265Z. cada linha do log do runner tem carimbo com 100 ns; a linha da tarefa só fecha (newline) quando o closure termina, então fim = carimbo da linha e início = carimbo da linha anterior. A janela inclui o trabalho feito ANTES do closure (key:generate, BancoSqlite, senha) e o código entre tarefas.
detail.en: php artisan kit:install --ansi in job instalacao of run 44536758392 (ubuntu-latest), no --create-project, no TTY, tenancy off (.env.example). Origin 0 ms = job log line 407 timestamp (##[group]Run cp .env.example .env) = 2026-11-19T13:46:36.5638265Z. Each runner log line has a 100 ns timestamp; a task line ends (newline) only when its closure ends, so end = line timestamp and start = prior line timestamp. The window includes work done BEFORE the closure (key:generate, BancoSqlite, password) and code between tasks.
